texts.documents.workbook.distribution.note: The sites the {{term:Site}} Performance sheet leaves out, and the measures they own. A distribution centre holds stock and books no turnover, so it has no line on a {{term:site}} P&L and a volume and a cost of its own here. The network total is the sum of the {{term:divisions}} that have one, not of every {{term:division}}.
